type.description: The job trigger type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.
type.caption: Type

user.description: The user that pertains to the job trigger. Can be populated when the Event (3) type that bounds to specific user is used.
user.caption: User

properties.description:
The list of properties associated with the trigger.
Can be used to describe time boundaries of the job, amount of repetitions or when the job should be activated or expired.
properties.caption: Properties

3.description: The job is triggered when the specific event occurs. The properties attribute should be populated with respective event sources and identifiers.
3.caption: Event

1.description: The job is triggered on a system boot.
1.caption: Boot

2.description: The job is triggered on a specific schedule. Properties should be populated with respective time bounds.
2.caption: Schedule

99.description: The job trigger is unmapped. See the type attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
99.caption: Other

type_id.description: The job trigger type, i.e. the condition that must be met for the job to perform its action.
type_id.caption: Type ID

event_codes.description: Event identifiers that pertain to the job trigger. Should be populated when the Event (3) type is specified.
event_codes.caption: Event Codes

last_run_time.description: The time when the job was last run.
last_run_time.caption: Last Run

log_sources.description: A collection of log systems or components that pertain to the job trigger. Should be populated when the Event (3) type is specified.
log_sources.caption: Log Sources

next_run_time.description: The time when the job will next be run.
next_run_time.caption: Next Run

last_run_time_dt.description: The time when the job was last run.
last_run_time_dt.caption: Last Run

next_run_time_dt.description: The time when the job will next be run.
next_run_time_dt.caption: Next Run

name: job_trigger
description: The condition or event that, when met, will initiate the job to perform specified actions.
caption: Job Trigger
